what: When the list enters the band at the bottom 25% of the screen, each row’s underline is drawn from the left over .6s ease, staggered .1s per row. Then .2s later the row’s inner block, with its top 40px clipped, drops 40px from above over .3s (opacity .2s) and is revealed — numbered reason rows and FAQ rows fall in one after another and settle into place (once only).

options.--fx-line-out: Distance to push the underline outside the line (via style, negative), default 0px
options.[data-fx-part=row]: Line (required) — its direct children drop down

from.where: index reasons line (.c-num-set01) · FAQ (.js-c-line-mask-anim), service process order line
